title.narrative: Kolkata Environmental Improvement Investment Program - Tranche 2

description.narrative: Tranche 2 will continue improvements in coverage and operational sustainability of Kolkata Municipal Corporation's sewerage, drainage, and water supply services. The accompanying TA will strengthen climate resilience of Kolkata through improved planning and disaster risk management.

Reports and Recommendations of the President
Loan 3413: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 06 May 2025

Progress Toward Outcome: While the loan closed on 31 August 2023, ongoing spillover works are currently being funded by the state. It is anticipated that the envisioned outcome and outputs of the project design and monitoring framework will be achieved upon the successful completion of all ongoing works.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Dec 2023: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/42266/42266-025-apfs-en_4.pdf

Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Apr 2023: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/42266/42266-025-smr-en_10.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: 105 KMC officials have undergone training, with 99 males and 6 eligible female staff. The SCADA system has been upgraded, commissioned, and handed over to the line department, now in operation. The hydraulic modeling of the transmission main is included in the Water Loss Roadmap, with bulk meters installed and integrated into the upgraded SCADA. The DMA established in one pilot project of WLM will be replicated in all three zones, where one project has been completed or is in completion stage.Under WS01, works completed and commissioned, and NRW is less than 25%, while works under WS 25 are ongoing. NRW achievement is expected upon completion. 22 CSCs are established in different locations within 16 Boroughs of KMC. A centralized grievance management cell has been set up at KMC for better grievance management. Nine elevated reservoirs with a capacity of 17,100 KL and two ground-level service reservoirs with a capacity of 22 ML have been constructed against their respective targets.28 km of transmission mains, 444 km of distribution mains, and 35,242 additional water meters have been installed and maintained. The property tax collection efficiency ratio of KMC has improved to 83% in the fiscal year 2018-19. An early warning system has been installed, implemented, and handed over to KMC, along with an operation and maintenance manual developed under the TA. The final report on climate-resilient infrastructure, land use planning, and disaster management has been submitted to KMC.A total of 127 staff (95 males and 32 females) have been trained on ADB policies and gender mainstreaming, with awareness campaigns on social leadership and behavioral change related to health, hygiene, and sanitation. During the period between 2015 to 2021, KMC provided building sanction in these peripheral areas to 16,975 number of properties (each having at least one drainage connection) for construction that included properties/apartments with minimum two floors (stories/levels) to multiple floors (stories/levels). All female-headed households are covered within the sanctions. Additionally, 109 km of sewer drainpipes have been constructed, including 7.05 km using micro-tunneling. An extra pumping station and 3.50 km of pumping main have been completed against their respective targets.While the loan closed on 31 August 2023, spillover works are ongoing with state funds. The envisaged outcome and outputs of the project design and monitoring framework are likely to be achieved upon the completion of all ongoing works.
